annotations.title: LGA · Employment by industry and occupation

description:
What employed residents do for a living: head-counts and shares across 19 industries and 8 occupation groups, for every suburb and council area.

Coverage: About 8,800 suburbs and localities and 540 council areas across Australia (areas with fewer than 50 employed residents are left out); one snapshot at 10 August 2021. Current to 2021-08-10. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/employment-by-industry`.

**Price: 10¢ per call.**

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of: employed_residents, ind_agriculture_forestry_fishing_count, ind_agriculture_forestry_fishing_pct, ind_mining_count, ind_mining_pct, ind_manufacturing_count, ind_manufacturing_pct, ind_utilities_count, ind_utilities_pct, ind_construction_count, ind_construction_pct, ind_wholesale_trade_count, ind_wholesale_trade_pct, ind_retail_trade_count, ind_retail_trade_pct, ind_accommodation_food_count, ind_accommodation_food_pct, ind_transport_postal_warehousing_count, ind_transport_postal_warehousing_pct, ind_media_telecommunications_count, ind_media_telecommunications_pct, ind_finance_insurance_count, ind_finance_insurance_pct, ind_rental_hiring_real_estate_count, ind_rental_hiring_real_estate_pct, ind_professional_scientific_technical_count, ind_professional_scientific_technical_pct, ind_administrative_support_count, ind_administrative_support_pct, ind_public_administration_safety_count, ind_public_administration_safety_pct, ind_education_training_count, ind_education_training_pct, ind_health_care_social_assistance_count, ind_health_care_social_assistance_pct, ind_arts_recreation_count, ind_arts_recreation_pct, ind_other_services_count, ind_other_services_pct, ind_industry_not_stated_count, ind_industry_not_stated_pct, occ_managers_count, occ_managers_pct, occ_professionals_count, occ_professionals_pct, occ_technicians_trades_count, occ_technicians_trades_pct, occ_community_personal_service_count, occ_community_personal_service_pct, occ_clerical_admin_count, occ_clerical_admin_pct, occ_sales_count, occ_sales_pct, occ_machinery_drivers_count, occ_machinery_drivers_pct, occ_labourers_count, occ_labourers_pct, occ_occupation_not_stated_count, occ_occupation_not_stated_pct. Omit for all.

lga_name.description: Council (LGA) name exactly as /v1/lga/list returns it, e.g. `Lake Macquarie`.

to.description: Last period to include, same formats as `from`.
